sources.title: LFM2.5-24B-A2B: Built for Fast On-Device Agents - liquid.ai
sources.snippet: Today, we release LFM2.5-24B-A2B, a 24B-parameter reasoning model with just 2B active parameters, built for fast, private agents on-device. It is the largest and final model in the LFM2.5 family, which now spans two orders of magnitude: from LFM2.5-230M to LFM2.5-24B-A2B.

sources.title: Liquid AI Releases Open-Weight LFM2.5-24B-A2B for On-Device ...
sources.snippet: Liquid AI released LFM2.5-24B-A2B on October 13, 2026, an open-weight 24B-parameter reasoning model with 2B active parameters built for agents that run on-device. The company published the base and post-trained checkpoints on Hugging Face and detailed the release in a post on the Hugging Face blog.
